decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - Prior to the commencement of the development hereby permitted, a full method statement detailing the means of fixing the trunking and security grills to the building shall be submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. 
Note: Fixings must be inserted within the mortar joints rather than into the brick and stonework.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unnumbered Location Plan; Heritage Statement; Planning Statement; Design and Access Statement; Unnumbered Security Grills Drawing; Window Report. Received 12/09/2018. Email from Paul Gibbinson. Received 29/10/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The holes made in the walls of the building shall be no larger than 40mm.
Condition : 5 - Prior to the commencement of the development hereby permitted, samples of trunking and security grills shall be submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: installation of a single electrical ring around the interior perimeter of the two chapels and installation of security grills over all windows
